operator_statement: В подключении к TP23 есть последовательный резистор 1 кОм, как раньше
required_clarification: Is the resistor in the added TP23-to-PA4 branch, or in the existing TP23-to-PA6/BKIN path?
corrected_continuity_expectation: If added TP23-to-PA4 branch contains 1k series resistor, expect about 1k ohm, not near zero. Existing TP23-to-PA6 path depends on actual resistor location. Do not treat expected 1k as an open circuit.
